hooks.command: umask 077; d="$HOME/.local/state/super-watch"; mkdir -p "$d" && if [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET" ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN" ]; then printf '%s\n%s\n' "$CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET" "$CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_TOKEN" > "$d/inbox-socket.tmp" && mv -f "$d/inbox-socket.tmp" "$d/inbox-socket"; else rm -f "$d/inbox-socket"; fi >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
